title_en: Visions of the Future (15/20): Dreams of a Robot Maid
note_en: 既…又… joins two qualities that are both true, like "both… and…": Robby the robot is 既聪明又彬彬有礼 "both clever and impeccably polite." Its negative partner is 既不…也不…, "neither… nor…": the robot vacuum 既不会说话，也不会做饭 "could neither talk nor cook." Unlike English "both/neither," 既 sits right before the first verb or adjective, after the subject.
